Timet
Pre-conditions.

Info-structure

Timet is the story of the creation of
a symbolic system. After 10 years

of research and experimentations, we can begin to outline
the elements of

an aesthetic and conceptual extension, which follow and
introduce all the

works of the group.

Our History is mainly a music history. In the last years
we have been applying our methods to any
symbolic language, chasing a multi-linguistic artwork
we are still building up.

Methodology.

- Art of Data Transfiguration .

.Digital editing as Art of Data Transfiguration; our
operating tools are analogue and digital data
processing and design.

.Generating complex materials re-editable for multiple
relationships. Inside and outside Timet.

Complex means the hybrid dimension of a music aggregate,
constituted by electro-edited data and natural sources
(like
acoustic musician’s interpretations): complex materials
and the single note belong to the same potential and
common world of
sonic experience.

.Editing, processing and inter-mixing imply that any
compositional identity is a dynamic, multiply
referenced and nonlinear status.

.we are building a symbolic open database, where all
the data are available for multiple and nonlinear compositions:

To free compositions and their sources is a methodological
and ethic decision, in order to increase an active, critical,
interrelated and extended idea of symbolic systems.

Comprehension through editing : acting in a dynamic and
editable symbolic world.

To Use : free re-contextualization of any music reference.

To refer : pointing out relevancies and analytic links
to pure and elementary sources.

People networking

From sound design and music composition to sound gardening
and digital architecture. Timet is open
to different collaborations and linguistic perspectives.

and technology

projects.title: Timet perspectives on Classicism / Hyper Classicism
projects.bodyText:
Timet
perspectives on Classicism.

1- The idea of classicism refers to a cognitive
public frame. We intend to criticize a static idea of
music heritage.

We are suggesting an ETHIC OF USING and ABUSING of cultural heritage.

We also defend a sophisticated preservation of the access to and availability of all the original sources at any processing level.

2- Memory as a collective memory.

A dialectical, dynamic and actually electronic confrontation between music
histories
exemplifies the circle of cultural synthesis .

Timet is against a strict and not-symbolic author-right legislation.

See

. Easyclassics - DVD . Cosottini, Brusci.
Timet, 2002. (mp3 stereo version from the original 5.1 standard)

projects.title: Sonic architectures
projects.bodyText:
Sonic
architectures.

We intend a livable environment
as an open process in its synthetic, multiple and reversible
evidence.

Any music aggregate is a symbol of a living process and expresses dynamic relationships
between any perceptual elements.

From our perspective a symbolic system is expressive (and logic) when it’s
deeply editable.

The editability makes dynamic and alive any symbolic system.

Symbolic systems are/stay for possible environments.

To free a complex music, integrated in a livable space.

Aesthetic Contents are an alternative reality model. A continuous symbolic
world, made by dynamic identities and the reversibility of any state.

Synchronicity and Environment are contextinterfaces between Man and Complexity.

-Ecology of a dynamic open space.

-Immaterial Architecture.

-Multiplicity and habitat. A nonlinear architecture. An active process.

projects.title: Metalanguages and Nonlinearity
projects.bodyText:
Metalanguages
and Nonlinearity

The forced association between traditional
(conventional) stylistic

values and music research, from the start assumed "relationship",
or

" contextuality", as relevant compositional data. We spontaneously

constructed scores which included metaphorical instructions to all or a

specific type of musician; the codification of Lorenzo's gestures and performative
behavior were the first hint of a nonlinear composition obtained by the conduction;

the use of improvisation subjected to strict timbrical, dynamical, harmonic,

rhythmical and metaphorical laws persued the idea of improvisation as the

possibility to apply a contemporary musician’s complexity and compositional
ability inside specific macro-semantic grids (1995).

In defining the aggregates which resulted from the individual

experiments/improvisations and in stabilizing the nature of pre-recorded

sample-aggregates, the idea of metacomposition (the treatment of music aggregates
as sonic “elements”) often surfaced.

These two approaches had a common need for the heterogeneous components to
flow inside of a composition which can no longer refer to any traditional 'ensemble'
laws, and to now make use of contextuality, of the fusion betweeen electronic
and acoustic bodies, and of free editing of previous recordings, as the main
compositional characteristic (on the line of any phonografic art).

The fragile harmonic condition of an aggregate inside a metacomposition necessarly
meets the need for a nonlinear composition:

the possibility of each aggregate and performative context to live within more
than one possible musical relationship .

Nonlinearity. Multiple solutions for an intentional artwork.

Nonlinear instructions. An inter-language theory

Didactictraining to our editing and performing languages.

Examples:

. Partitura Viva.
A Living Score .

projects.title: Open database
projects.bodyText:
Open
database.

Interfaces/complexity.

We can produce specific sounds and operate data-research for specific

environmental needs.

We assume that anyone digitally produce his own music environment: djing and
home sound processing are average music gestures.

Timet organizes access to and evident relationships between a huge number of

his own compositional data.

Our database is organized to be re-played.

We freely provide Timet elementary music information to increase external compositional
experiences.

All our music materials are under EFF datashare licence.

Ex. Open and Share DATA Experiences

projects.bodyText:

SAMPLING Art

The 5 re-cyclying totems

.a metamusic quintet.

sampling art by Lorenzo Brusci

5 totems by artists Giampaolo Di Cocco, Filippo Tincolini,
Simone Zanaglia, Giacomo Bonciolini

Sound Installation.

Sampled composers, among others: F. Zappa, G. Clinton,
G. Ligeti, S. Barrett, Bach, L. Berio, N. Cave, A. Artaud,
J. Coltrane, Bomporti, G. Petrassi, K. Penderecki, Beatles,
O. Coleman, B. Eno, Pergolesi, Monteverdi.

“…
is it possible to give a synthetical and analogue short
impression of an entire compositional life?

Inside the sonic totems built by our visual collaborators,
we locate our music meta-bodies, results of a radical
sampling art.

We tried out real concentrations of music experiences Totems are syncronic,
they set up a real meta-music quintet…”.

Rights and Men of the new era.

Featuring Andrea de Luca

Music by Timet

Installation and performance for voice and electronics.

“No fear. No war. No sorrow. No oblivion. No starvation.
No violence. No humiliation.

Can music and words be an invitation for a new era of
civil involvement?

Abstractions and deep reality belong to the same wish:

it’s possible to build a different awareness of
any detail of human life;

it’s possible to belong to the same world of opportunity
with equal dignity…”.
